# Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Register — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Document Location:** `docs/pm/BAA-REGISTER.md`  
> **Regulation:** HIPAA (45 CFR § 164.502(e) and § 164.504(e))  
> **Requirement:** Mandatory executed BAA with every vendor, sub-processor, or cloud platform that creates, receives, maintains, or transmits Protected Health Information (PHI).  
> **Last Updated:** {YYYY-MM-DD}  
> **BAA Custodian / Legal Officer:** {Name, Title}

---

## 1. Statutory Notice on Self-Serve PaaS & SaaS Accounts

⚠️ **CRITICAL WARNING:**  
Standard self-serve PaaS accounts (e.g. standard Vercel Pro, Railway, Heroku, standard Supabase Pro, generic email APIs like SendGrid free tier) **DO NOT execute BAAs** without enterprise-tier contractual addendums. Storing or transmitting ePHI through a vendor without an active, countersigned BAA is a federal statutory violation regardless of encryption controls.

## 3. Sub-Processor ePHI Scrubbing Verification

Before data leaves the application boundary to any third-party logging, analytics, or error-reporting service:

- [ ] **Sentry / Error Tracking:** Client-side and server-side scrubbers configured to redact patient names, emails, medical record numbers (MRNs), and tokens before payload transmission (`beforeSend` hook implemented).
- [ ] **Analytics (PostHog / Mixpanel):** IP anonymization enabled; strictly zero clinical attributes or patient IDs passed in event properties.
- [ ] **AI / LLM Services (OpenAI / Anthropic):** Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement active and BAA executed if clinical text or appointment reason is processed via LLM endpoints.
